name: Ayam Penyet President - Century Square
description:
MUST TRY: Expect indulgent signatures such as Grilled Boneless Milk Fish, Catfish in Sundanese Gravy, Fried Rice a la President, Beef Rendang, Fresh Vegetables, and a lot more. Ayam Penyet President offers some of the best Halal and Indonesian cuisines in Singapore, serving a tantalizing collection of dishes that are suitable for casual dining and group gatherings. Located at Century Square along Tampines Central 5 (nearest train: Tampines MRT Station), this casual dining restaurant provides a casual and friendly atmosphere where families and friends get to try authentic Indonesian food that will surely deliver a memorable dining experience and gastronomic indulgence. 
Source: hungrygowhere.com
